components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true

      properties:

          type: integer

          minimum: 0

        - id

## Summary

The change normalizes an owner's telephone on create: strip all non-digit characters, require exactly 10 digits, store/return the bare 10-digit value, and reject with 400 otherwise.

Two files touched, both edits tiny:

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — relaxed the `telephone` bean-validation pattern from `^[0-9]*$` to `^(\D*\d){10}\D*$`. This makes the generated DTO accept exactly-10-digit input with any separators (e.g. `(04) 1234-5678`) and reject anything with a different digit count (e.g. `12345`) — the rejection flows through the existing `MethodArgumentNotValidException` handler as a clean **400**, so no new exception type or handler was needed.

2. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — added a small `@Named("normalizeTelephone")` default method that strips non-digits, and wired the `toOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)` mapping to it. Because that mapper method is used *only* by `addOwner` (create), the normalization is scoped precisely to the create path; `updateOwner` uses setters directly and is untouched.

**Why this keeps structural impact low:** I avoided editing the large `OwnerRestControllerV1` (high `WMC_other`) and the `Owner` entity. The reject-with-400 reuses existing bean validation rather than adding branching logic, and the only new code is a self-contained one-line method in the small mapper interface (low surrounding complexity). The entity's existing `@Pattern(^[0-9]{10}$)` / `@Digits` still hold post-normalization, so no model change was required.
